name: html-purifier-ts
description: Spec-compliant HTML sanitizer in TypeScript: own tokenizer + tree builder with SVG/MathML namespace handling, mXSS-safe serialization

scripts.build: npm run gen:entities && tsc && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.bundle.js && esbuild demo/demo.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=demo/sanitizer-demo.bundle.js
